topic: In Two Blue Vortex chapter 37 Kawaki kidnaps Kashin Koji so Amado can force his future sight and find a way to save Sarada from Code
title: Kawaki Kidnapped His Own Ally To Save Sarada
description: In Two Blue Vortex chapter 37, Kawaki drags his own ally to Amado, and it is not the betrayal it looks like. Here's why Kashin Koji's future sight is the only thing that can save Sarada from Code. Do you think Kawaki did the right thing?
comment: Was Kawaki right to kidnap Koji, or did he just make an enemy out of an ally? Pick one.

lines.text: Kawaki just kidnapped his own ally, and it was not a betrayal.

shot.fallback: white haired young ninja with a scar, tense expression

lines.text: In Two Blue Vortex chapter 37, Kawaki drags Kashin Koji straight to Amado.

shot.fallback: old scientist standing before a hooded masked man

lines.text: Koji carries Ten Directions, a power that shows every possible future.

shot.fallback: hooded figure with a glowing eye seeing visions of the future

lines.text: Amado built that ability years ago from Otsutsuki cells.

shot.fallback: scientist in a lab coat examining a glowing cell sample

lines.text: But Koji never controlled when the visions came. Sometimes it took weeks.

shot.fallback: hooded figure sitting perfectly still, eyes closed in deep focus

lines.text: So Amado does something drastic. He forces Koji's brain to speed the visions up.

shot.fallback: scientist attaching wires to a seated hooded figure's head

lines.text: Why the rush? Because Code just took Sarada.

shot.fallback: young kunoichi trapped inside a dark glowing cage

lines.text: And Boruto wants one answer only. Is there a way to save her?

shot.fallback: blue eyed young ninja with a worried, determined expression

lines.text: Here's the part fans keep missing.

shot.fallback: close up of a stern young ninja's face

lines.text: Kawaki is not doing this for Boruto. He is doing it to keep Naruto's world standing.

shot.fallback: scarred ninja looking toward a distant hokage figure

lines.text: His pride took a real hit letting Koji get captured like this.

shot.fallback: ninja clenching his fist, frustrated expression

lines.text: But protecting the village still comes before his ego every time.

shot.fallback: hidden leaf village skyline at night, tense atmosphere

lines.text: That is the real Kawaki nobody gives him credit for.

shot.fallback: young ninja standing guard, resolute expression, dramatic lighting

lines.text: So when Kawaki kidnapped his own ally, it was not a betrayal...

shot.fallback: young ninja walking forward with resolve, dramatic lighting

self_check.hook: leads with Kawaki and the twist claim in under 2 seconds
self_check.loop: final line repeats line 1's opening clause so it flows back into it
